notes: Six web searches ran; none was refused. Results for Wilson and AI were thin, so the search may be incomplete. Not a sponsor or cosponsor of the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act (H.R. 10538, introduced 24 September 2026): the FastDemocracy page (https://fastdemocracy.com/bill-search/us/119/bills/USB00108512/, opened) lists 12 cosponsors and she is not among them; Congress.gov returned HTTP 403. No House letter about AI risk signed or led by her was found (the many-signer August and September 2026 letters were not searched, per instructions). Opened directly: her press releases page (https://wilson.house.gov/media/press-releases, first page only, 10 releases from 25 June to 7 October 2026, none about AI) and her Science, Space, and Technology issue page (only a September 2025 item on vaccine mandates). Her fiscal year 2026 community projects page lists an Everglades research project whose description mentions artificial intelligence/machine learning; this is a funding request description, not her own statement about AI, and was not opened. Older press releases on her technology subcommittee role and a cyber-space hearing appear to predate 2025 and were not opened.
